title: Alternative Microbial Cell-Division and Reproductive Strategies
method: Visible teaching paragraph text before Part B, with tags separated by whitespace and entities normalized; excludes figures, tables, headings, UI, practice and references. Total includes captions, questions, answers, tables, headings and reference titles; excludes SVG internals and enlargement buttons.
comparator: 2.E.04 checkpoint: 14,080 narrative words; 2.D.10: 7,560. Current chapter independently recounted from stored HTML: 14448 words across 13 substantive theory sections; length is supplementary to scope coverage.
scientific_checks: Approved node map and official revised merged NET Unit 2.E p.3 plus archived MP SET 2024 Unit 2.E p.2 visually inspected. Source-supported bacterial budding/Hyphomonas, Caulobacter replication competence, yeast nuclear segregation, algal commitment, bacterial baeocytes, reproductive vs vegetative Streptomyces septation, hormogonia, ordinary endospore topology and differentiation, Ca-DPA/SASPs and germination, and rare internal-offspring exceptions. Two editorial self-review passes, with additional source anchors, mechanistic evidence and controls, germ cell wall and diagram DNA allocations revised. Checked quantitative examples: 20% of 5=1 and 200 of 1000; 12 offspring net 11; 4×3=12; 12 prospective/10 viable; 20×8=160, 15×8=120; mother+4=5; ln8/3=ln2; 40×4×0.75=120, net 80, 40×0.75=30; 96/8=12 and 96/4=24; 40 compartments/5=8. Part C arithmetic checked: 240/120/960; 6; 20 and 8; 600 and 150; 480; 80% and 60%; 210 and 140; 1 and 200. Hypothetical datasets and original practice, not past-year questions.
limitations: Editorial review was independent in role, not an external human peer review. Static source checks and schematic-coordinate review, not interactive browser/device tests or a full accessibility audit. SET comparator is an archived 2024 copy. Unpublished immediate neighbors remain disabled. Live deployment verification is separate and pending at commit.
